description: This file contains extension methods for IClientBuilder in the Orleans framework, enabling configuration of client connection behaviors such as retry policies, clustering options, and event handlers.

classes.name: ClientBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IClientBuilder to configure Orleans client options.

classes.name: DelegateConnectionRetryFilter
classes.description: A private nested class implementing IClientConnectionRetryFilter, wrapping a delegate for retry decision logic.

methods.name: UseConnectionRetryFilter
methods.description: Adds a custom delegate-based connection retry filter to the Orleans client configuration.

methods.name: UseConnectionRetryFilter
methods.description: Adds a given IClientConnectionRetryFilter instance as the retry policy.

methods.name: UseConnectionRetryFilter
methods.description: Adds a retry filter specified by type TConnectionRetryFilter.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Adds additional services to the Orleans client builder via a delegate.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures options of a specified type via a delegate.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Binds a configuration instance to options of a specified type.

methods.name: AddGatewayCountChangedHandler
methods.description: Registers a GatewayCountChangedHandler using a factory.

methods.name: AddClusterConnectionStatusObserver
methods.description: Registers a cluster connection status observer.

methods.name: AddClusterConnectionLostHandler
methods.description: Registers a ConnectionToClusterLostHandler using a factory.

methods.name: AddActivityPropagation
methods.description: Enables propagation of Activity.Current through grain calls.

methods.name: UseLocalhostClustering
methods.description: Configures the client to connect to a localhost silo with specified or default ports, cluster id, and service id.

methods.name: UseStaticClustering
methods.description: Configures static clustering with specified endpoints or options.
